title: ExplorerUsage
responsibility: Lists revision-scoped consumers through shared navigable screenshot-preview links.

inputs.name: ExplorerUsage.consumers
inputs.description: Referenced consumers at the shown revision, or empty for a dash.

inputs.name: ExplorerUsage.nav
inputs.description: Navigation preserving the selected branch and commit.

inputs.name: ExplorerUsage.lens
inputs.description: The selected revision evidence resolver; no screenshot is borrowed from another entity.

inputs.name: ExplorerUsage.mediaBase
inputs.description: URL prefix resolving the referenced screenshot file.

inputs.name: ExplorerUsage.layout
inputs.description: Optional consumer presentation; defaults to category headings, while flat keeps the same links without category labels.

inputs.name: ExplorerUsage.limit
inputs.description: Optional most links the flat list shows, in its canonical order; unbounded by default. Omitted consumers end the list with a visible ellipsis and read-out count.

outputs.name: ExplorerUsage
outputs.description: Compact Used In links or a dash; grouped by default, with a flat layout for model and component cards using the same preview links. A limited flat list adds an ellipsis only when consumers are omitted.
